author: Dragonfirewolf2
name: AuditLog
short: Poll Roblox group audit logs and post new events to Discord.
description: Monitors Roblox group audit logs (rank changes, kicks, bans, join requests, etc.) via the Roblox legacy-groups Open Cloud endpoint and posts embeds for new entries. Group list is hardcoded in the source — edit MONITORED_GROUPS to change. Requires ROBLOX_API_KEY env var with group audit-log read permission.
